reply.emotion: quiet and domestic, closing the door behind you at the end of the day
notes: While 'habitación' can mean any room in a house, it is most commonly used to mean 'bedroom' in everyday conversation.

senses.definition: Cada uno de los espacios de una casa, separados por paredes, donde se vive o se duerme.

examples.text: Mi casa tiene tres habitaciones y un salón grande.
examples.translation: My house has three rooms and a large living room.
examples.emotion: proud and welcoming, showing someone around your home

doubts: a definition of la habitación reads as Spanish, and the vocabulary defines its senses in English
